turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My friends invited me on a hike but the forecast says rain in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Tricky. You could start very early and be down before the rain, or move the hike to another day. What do you think?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, can you wait? My friend is talking to me. Keep quiet until I come back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, when does your passport expire? I need to check before I book anything.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Uh, sometime next year I think. Let me look.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Some countries want six months left on it, so it matters.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Okay, found it. It's good until next August.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Perfect, that works. Mine's fine too.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Any decision on the rainy hike?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Postpone. Muddy trails are no fun.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair. Next weekend looks drier, so suggest that to the group.
